Rate limiting

In computer networks, rate limiting is used to control the rate of requests sent or received by a network interface controller.

It can be used to prevent DoS attacks and limit web scraping. Research indicates flooding rates for one zombie machine are in excess of 20 HTTP GET requests per second.
